releaseNotes.sw: Michango mpya: pakia orodha ya ahadi kutoka Excel, tuma vikumbusho kwa SMS na WhatsApp, kadi ya Michango yenye jina na ahadi ya kila mtu, na kiolezo cha salamu za Kiislamu.
releaseNotes.en: New Michango: import pledges from Excel, send SMS and WhatsApp reminders, a Michango card with each person's name and pledge, and an Islamic greeting template.
